sentences.en: During the course of character segmentation, we make the best of the apriority knowledge of the normal license plate and use the vertical projection to segment it into single characters.

sentences.en: Officials in both parties said that resolving the southerners'grievances was apriority.

sentences.en: In fact, this "middle-class" government is not only a subjective product characteristic of apriority and utopianism , but also has extreme strong class-consciousness.

sentences.en: The third section is for the analysis of the advantage and disadvantage of the apriority of the moral laws.

sentences.en: Wang Yangming endowed intuitive knowledge with various connotations in order to verify its apriority, universality and absoluteness.

sentences.en: On the basis of discussion and analysis, I distinguish the advantage and disadvantage of the apriority of the moral laws, and think carefully about the moral principle.
sentences.vi: Trên cơ sở thảo luận và phân tích, tôi phân biệt ưu điểm và nhược điểm của thâm niên của các quy luật luân lý, đồng thời suy nghĩ thấu đáo về nguyên tắc luân lý.

sentences.en: Kant found out the established warranty for knowledge by formulating the apriority " of apperception."
